# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Sami: Sweden 1970 and Nordic cooperation.
# COLDWAR Sweden. Generated by tools/sweden_1970/build_national.py.
COLDWAR_SWE_national_accept_procurement_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = event_target:COLDWAR_SWE_partner_procurement
			SWE = {
				exists = yes
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_pending_procurement
			}
			NOT = {
				has_war_with = SWE
			}
			SWE = {
				AND = {
					set_temp_variable = {
						COLDWAR_SWE_national_required_budget = {
							value = gdp_total
							multiply = 0.01
						}
					}
					check_variable = {
						var = treasury
						value = COLDWAR_SWE_national_required_budget
						compare = greater_than_or_equals
					}
				}
			}
			has_equipment = {
				infantry_weapons_1 > 999
			}
		}
		SWE = {
			set_temp_variable = {
				treasury_change = {
					value = gdp_total
					multiply = -0.01
				}
			}
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = {
			treasury_change = {
				value = SWE.gdp_total
				multiply = 0.01
			}
		}
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		send_equipment = {
			type = infantry_weapons_1
			amount = 1000
			target = SWE
		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_requested_procurement
		SWE = {
			subtract_from_variable = {
				COLDWAR_SWE_pending_count = 1
			}
			clamp_variable = {
				var = COLDWAR_SWE_pending_count
				min = 0
			}
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_political_external_open
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_pending_procurement
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_delivered_procurement
			set_country_flag = {
				flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_active_procurement
				days = 720
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_accepted_procurement
			COLDWAR_SWE_national_refresh_effect = yes
		}
		COLDWAR_SWE_national_reply_status_effect = yes
	}
}

					check_variable = {
						var = treasury
						value = COLDWAR_SWE_national_required_budget
						compare = greater_than_or_equals
					}
				}
			}
			SWE = {
				check_variable = {
					COLDWAR_SWE_active_count < 24
				}
			}
			ROOT = {
				AND = {
					set_temp_variable = {
						COLDWAR_SWE_national_required_budget = {
							value = gdp_total
							multiply = 0.01
						}
					}
					check_variable = {
						var = treasury
						value = COLDWAR_SWE_national_required_budget
						compare = greater_than_or_equals
					}
				}
			}
		}
		SWE = {
			set_temp_variable = {
				treasury_change = {
					value = gdp_total
					multiply = -0.01
				}
			}
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
		}
		ROOT = {
			set_temp_variable = {
				treasury_change = {
					value = gdp_total
					multiply = -0.01
				}
			}
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
		}
		SWE = {
			add_to_variable = {
				COLDWAR_SWE_active_count = 1
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_counted_aircraft
		}
		SWE = {
			add_timed_idea = {
				idea = COLDWAR_SWE_national_agreement_aircraft
				days = 720
			}
		}
		add_timed_idea = {
			idea = COLDWAR_SWE_national_agreement_aircraft
			days = 720
		}
		SWE = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_delivered_aircraft
					}
				}
				add_tech_bonus = {
					name = COLDWAR_SWE_national_joint_aircraft
					bonus = 0.5
					uses = 1
					category = CAT_medium_aircraft
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_reward_aircraft
				}
			}
			add_tech_bonus = {
				name = COLDWAR_SWE_national_joint_aircraft
				bonus = 0.5
				uses = 1
				category = CAT_medium_aircraft
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_reward_aircraft
		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_requested_aircraft
		SWE = {
			subtract_from_variable = {
				COLDWAR_SWE_pending_count = 1
			}
			clamp_variable = {
				var = COLDWAR_SWE_pending_count
				min = 0
			}
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_political_external_open
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_pending_aircraft
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_delivered_aircraft
			set_country_flag = {
				flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_active_aircraft
				days = 720
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_accepted_aircraft
			COLDWAR_SWE_national_refresh_effect = yes
		}
		COLDWAR_SWE_national_reply_status_effect = yes
	}
}

				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_pending_trade
			}
			NOT = {
				has_war_with = SWE

			SWE = {
				AND = {
					set_temp_variable = {

							value = gdp_total
							multiply = 0.01
						}
					}
					check_variable = {
						var = treasury
						value = COLDWAR_SWE_national_required_budget
						compare = greater_than_or_equals
					}
				}
			}
			ROOT = {
				AND = {
					set_temp_variable = {
						COLDWAR_SWE_national_required_budget = {
							value = gdp_total
							multiply = 0.01
						}
					}
					check_variable = {
						var = treasury
						value = COLDWAR_SWE_national_required_budget
						compare = greater_than_or_equals
					}
				}
			}
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_delivery_site_trade_chosen
			event_target:COLDWAR_SWE_delivery_site_trade = {
				is_owned_by = ROOT
				is_controlled_by = ROOT
				free_building_slots = { building = offices size > 0 include_locked = no }
			}
			SWE = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_swedish_trade_site_chosen
			}
			event_target:COLDWAR_SWE_swedish_trade_site = {
				is_owned_by = SWE
				is_controlled_by = SWE
				free_building_slots = { building = offices size > 0 include_locked = no }
			}
		}
		SWE = {
			set_temp_variable = {
				treasury_change = {
					value = gdp_total
					multiply = -0.01
				}
			}
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
		}
		ROOT = {
			set_temp_variable = {
				treasury_change = {
					value = gdp_total
					multiply = -0.01
				}
			}
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					SWE = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_delivered_trade
					}
				}
			}
			event_target:COLDWAR_SWE_delivery_site_trade = {
				add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
				add_building_construction = {
					type = offices
					level = 1
					instant_build = yes
				}
			}
			event_target:COLDWAR_SWE_swedish_trade_site = {
				add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
				add_building_construction = {
					type = offices
					level = 1
					instant_build = yes
				}
			}
			SWE = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_swedish_trade_site_chosen
			}
		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_delivery_site_trade_chosen
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_requested_trade
		SWE = {
			subtract_from_variable = {
				COLDWAR_SWE_pending_count = 1
			}
			clamp_variable = {
				var = COLDWAR_SWE_pending_count
				min = 0
			}
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_political_external_open
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_pending_trade

			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_political_external_open

				flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_active_aid
				days = 720
			}

COLDWAR_SWE_national_accept_export_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = event_target:COLDWAR_SWE_partner_export
			SWE = {
				exists = yes
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_pending_export
			}
			NOT = {
				has_war_with = SWE
			}
			SWE = {
				AND = {
					set_temp_variable = {
						COLDWAR_SWE_national_required_budget = {
							value = gdp_total
							multiply = 0.002
						}
					}
					check_variable = {
						var = treasury
						value = COLDWAR_SWE_national_required_budget
						compare = greater_than_or_equals
					}
				}
			}
			ROOT = {
				AND = {
					set_temp_variable = {
						COLDWAR_SWE_national_required_budget = {
							value = gdp_total
							multiply = 0.007
						}
					}
					check_variable = {
						var = treasury
						value = COLDWAR_SWE_national_required_budget
						compare = greater_than_or_equals
					}
				}
			}
			SWE = {
				has_equipment = {
					infantry_weapons_1 > 999
				}
			}
		}
		SWE = {
			set_temp_variable = {
				treasury_change = {
					value = gdp_total
					multiply = -0.002
				}
			}
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
		}
		ROOT = {
			set_temp_variable = {
				treasury_change = {
					value = gdp_total
					multiply = -0.007
				}
			}
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
		}
		SWE = {
			set_temp_variable = {
				treasury_change = {
					value = ROOT.gdp_total
					multiply = 0.007
				}
			}
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			send_equipment = {
				type = infantry_weapons_1
				amount = 1000
				target = ROOT
			}
		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_requested_export
		SWE = {
			subtract_from_variable = {
				COLDWAR_SWE_pending_count = 1
			}
			clamp_variable = {
				var = COLDWAR_SWE_pending_count
				min = 0
			}
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_political_external_open
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_pending_export
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_delivered_export
			set_country_flag = {
				flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_active_export
				days = 720
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_accepted_export
			COLDWAR_SWE_national_refresh_effect = yes
		}
		COLDWAR_SWE_national_reply_status_effect = yes
	}
}

				bonus = 0.5
				uses = 1
				category = CAT_industry

			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_reward_chinese

			}

		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_mediation_open
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_political_external_open
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_mediation_first_accepted
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_mediation_second_accepted
		subtract_from_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_pending_count = 1
		}
		clamp_variable = {
			var = COLDWAR_SWE_pending_count
			min = 0
		}
		event_target:COLDWAR_SWE_mediation_first = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_mediation_first_invited
			COLDWAR_SWE_national_reply_status_effect = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_mediation_second_named
			}
			event_target:COLDWAR_SWE_mediation_second = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_mediation_second_invited
				COLDWAR_SWE_national_reply_status_effect = yes
			}
		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_mediation_second_named
	}
}
COLDWAR_SWE_national_reply_status_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_requested_procurement
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_requested_aircraft
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_requested_security
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_requested_eastern
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_requested_nordic
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_requested_civilian
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_requested_trade
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_requested_aid
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_requested_export
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_requested_eastern_energy
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_requested_chinese
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_requested_research
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_mediation_first_invited
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_mediation_second_invited
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_reply_pending
	}
	else = {
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_reply_pending
	}
}

		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_accepted_nordic
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_procedure_resolved_v3_baltic_denial_joint_sea_training
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_v3_baltic_denial_joint_sea_training_procedure_resolved
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_v3_baltic_denial_joint_sea_training_contract_accepted
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_delivered_procurement
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_artillery_export_delivered

		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_regime_security_nationalist_security_review_court_procedure_resolved
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_regime_security_nationalist_security_review_court_contract_accepted
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_restoration_agreement_signed
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_procedure_resolved_regime_security_nationalist_competitive_election
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_v3_payload_ready_emergency_endgame_7
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_regime_security_nationalist_competitive_election_procedure_resolved
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_regime_security_nationalist_competitive_election_contract_accepted
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_standing_security_constitution_enacted
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_procedure_resolved_regime_security_nationalist_standing_authoritarian_state
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_v3_payload_ready_emergency_endgame_8
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_regime_security_nationalist_standing_authoritarian_state_procedure_resolved
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_regime_security_nationalist_standing_authoritarian_state_contract_accepted
	}
}
COLDWAR_SWE_national_contract_monthly_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_counted_aircraft
			NOT = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_active_aircraft
			}
		}
		subtract_from_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_active_count = 1
		}
		clamp_variable = {
			var = COLDWAR_SWE_active_count
			min = 0
		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_counted_aircraft
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_counted_security
			NOT = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_active_security
			}
		}
		subtract_from_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_active_count = 1
		}
		clamp_variable = {
			var = COLDWAR_SWE_active_count
			min = 0
		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_counted_security
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_counted_eastern
			NOT = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_active_eastern
			}
		}
		subtract_from_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_active_count = 1
		}
		clamp_variable = {
			var = COLDWAR_SWE_active_count
			min = 0
		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_counted_eastern
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_counted_nordic
			NOT = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_active_nordic
			}
		}
		subtract_from_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_active_count = 1
		}
		clamp_variable = {
			var = COLDWAR_SWE_active_count
			min = 0
		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_counted_nordic
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_counted_civilian
			NOT = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_active_civilian
			}
		}
		subtract_from_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_active_count = 1
		}
		clamp_variable = {
			var = COLDWAR_SWE_active_count
			min = 0
		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_agreement_counted_civilian
	}
}

COLDWAR_SWE_national_preview_offer_aid = {
	effect_tooltip = {
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SWE_offer_preview_aid_heading
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SWE_offer_preview_sweden
		# IMPERIA COLD WAR — MD standard (B7): native treasury line
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = -0.01000 } }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SWE_offer_preview_recipient_site
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SWE_offer_preview_first_delivery
		add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
		add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes }
	}
}
